CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3) is explicitly listed and accompanied by an origin/representation-status field, satisfying C,O,D for that referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation/access; labels like 'command_estimate' or 'candidate' alone do not qualify.

C.rationale: Multiple p0/current entries explicitly identify content coordinates with color attributes.

D.rationale: For the same referent/time, the report separately lists identified content and an origin/representation-status field.

O.rationale: The report describes how contents are presented (grid orientation) and provides structured representation/access metadata (current vs candidate origins/represented_time).
